title: DAC-Loop: Distillation-Aware Compression for Remote Sensing CNN
abstract: arXiv:2610.35175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While large-scale models achieve strong results in remote sensing scene classification, deploying them on edge devices remains difficult due to limited compute, memory, and energy budgets. Compact CNN backbones are therefore a practical choice in many real-world settings, offering efficient inference with well-optimized implementations on embedded hardware. To push this efficiency further, we investigate how far a knowledge-distilled student model can be compressed while preserving high accuracy. We propose a Distillation-Aware Compression Loop (DAC-Loop) that integrates (i) knowledge distillation applied both before and after structured channel pruning, and (ii) an iterative compression schedule that alternates structured pruning with unstructured sparsification. Across EuroSAT and NWPU-RESISC45, the DAC-Loop consistently improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to standard one-shot pruning and single-stage KD recovery, main

translated_title: DAC-Loop：面向遥感卷积神经网络的蒸馏感知压缩方法
translated_abstract: 尽管大规模模型在遥感场景分类中取得了优异的结果，但由于计算、内存和能源预算的限制，将其部署到边缘设备上仍然十分困难。因此，紧凑的CNN骨干网络在许多实际应用场景中成为了一种实用选择，其在嵌入式硬件上通过良好优化的实现可以提供高效的推理。为了进一步提升这种效率，我们研究了经过知识蒸馏的学生模型在保持高精度的同时能够被压缩到何种程度。我们提出了一种蒸馏感知压缩循环，它集成了以下两个方面： 结构化通道剪枝前后均应用知识蒸馏； 一种迭代式压缩调度方案，交替进行结构化剪枝和非结构化稀疏化。在EuroSAT和NWPU-RESISC45数据集上的实验表明，相对于标准的一次性剪枝和单阶段知识蒸馏恢复方法，DAC-Loop持续改善了精度与压缩率之间的权衡。
tldr: 提出DAC-Loop方法，通过在结构化剪枝前后应用知识蒸馏，并以迭代方式交替进行结构化剪枝与非结构化稀疏化，显著提升了遥感CNN在边缘设备部署中的精度-压缩权衡。
en_tdlr: DAC-Loop integrates knowledge distillation applied before and after structured channel pruning with an iterative schedule alternating structured pruning and unstructured sparsification, consistently improving the accuracy-compression trade-off for remote sensing CNNs on EuroSAT and NWPU-RESISC45.
